name: agenticros-skill-followme
description: Follow Me skill for AgenticROS — depth-based (optionally Ollama-VLM-assisted) person following with turn-to-track and search-when-lost.

agenticros.description: Depth-based person following with optional Ollama / VLM, turn-to-follow, and search-when-lost behaviors. The reference implementation of the skill contract.

capabilities.description: Drive forward while keeping a safe distance from whatever is in front of the camera (closed-loop on depth).
Take a snapshot and ask the local Ollama VLM what's in front of the robot — useful for verifying the follow target.
Report whether the local Ollama server is reachable and which vision model is installed.
